tracemalloc_clarification: tracemalloc explicitly measures Python-allocated heap memory via PyMem/PyObject allocators. It does NOT capture process-wide working sets, C/C++ library allocations (such as PyTorch native tensor storage or BLAS buffers), or GPU VRAM. Values represent the incremental Python tracing footprint.

discrepancy_explanation.text_modality: In historical report, sum of separate view runs was 28.073 ms vs composite run 34.414 ms (+6.341 ms). The separate runs were executed across different passes where SentenceTransformer forward pass experienced thread contention and cache eviction during consecutive unthrottled CPU inference. When measured synchronously within the identical invocation, the sum of views (32.4848 ms) matches the total pipeline (32.5847 ms) with only +0.0999 ms difference representing Python dictionary merging and dispatch overhead.
discrepancy_explanation.code_modality: In historical report, sum of separate view runs was 6.564 ms vs composite run 4.847 ms (-1.717 ms). The separate view runs were executed as 4 separate loops over 50 pairs, during which cold-start regex compilations (re._cache) and tokenizer string interning occurred. The composite pipeline was executed last, benefiting from warm regex caches and shared CPU branch tables. When measured synchronously within the identical invocation, the sum of views (5.4015 ms) matches the total pipeline (5.4826 ms) with only +0.0811 ms dispatch overhead.
